subject.title: feat(android): publish signed APKs with stable releases

question: Should PR #101212 make signed GitHub Release APKs the official stable Android distribution path now, with the proposed protected workflow, cert pin, provenance checks, and first-stable-tag observation plan?
rationale: This is not just a code correctness choice: it changes official Android distribution, signing-custody, release automation, and sideload-trust expectations for users.

options.title: Approve after release/security signoff
options.body: Accept the signed exact-tag APK workflow after release/security owners confirm environment secrets, dependency deltas, and first stable-tag observation steps.

options.title: Split before merge
options.body: Require the APK release workflow to land separately from unrelated app/provider/generated/dependency drift so the release-security review is narrower.

options.title: Pause official APK distribution
options.body: Keep Google Play as the only official Android channel for now and leave #9443 open for a later F-Droid or GitHub APK distribution decision.

recommendation.title: Approve after release/security signoff
recommendation.body: Accept the signed exact-tag APK workflow after release/security owners confirm environment secrets, dependency deltas, and first stable-tag observation steps.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author is also the strongest recent Android product/release routing signal and is named by dependency guard as trusted openclaw-secops for the dependency graph change.
